items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the Bußgeldbescheid
items.quote: Dieser Bußgeldbescheid wird rechtskräftig und vollstreckbar, wenn Sie nicht innerhalb von zwei Wochen nach Zustellung schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der oben bezeichneten Verwaltungsbehörde Einspruch einlegen.
items.computation: The letter includes a scan of the Zustellungsurkunde (formal postal service certificate, § 182 ZPO) showing actual delivery on 17.09.2026 (Thursday) - this documented delivery date is used instead of a fictional delivery rule, since it is proven on the record. Under §§ 43 StPO, 46 OWiG (period computed in analogy to § 187 BGB), the day of delivery itself is not counted; the two-week (14-day) period begins on 18.09.2026 and runs to the day before the same date two weeks later, i.e. ends on 01.10.2026 (Thursday). 01.10.2026 is not a Saturday, Sunday or Bavarian public holiday (Tag der Deutschen Einheit falls on 03.10.2026), so the deadline stands as computed.

items.title: Pay the total fine amount (Geldbuße, fee and expenses)
items.quote: Bitte zahlen Sie den Gesamtbetrag spätestens zwei Wochen nach Rechtskraft unter Angabe des Aktenzeichens auf das unten genannte Konto.
items.computation: Payment is due two weeks after the decision becomes final (Rechtskraft). Rechtskraft occurs automatically the day after the Einspruch period expires without an objection being filed, i.e. on 02.10.2026 (Friday), assuming no Einspruch is lodged by the 01.10.2026 deadline computed above. Counting two weeks (14 days) from that trigger date under the same day-not-counted rule (§ 187 BGB analogy) gives a due date of 16.10.2026 (Friday), which is not a weekend day or Bavarian public holiday, so it stands. This calculation is contingent on no Einspruch being filed; if an Einspruch is filed, Rechtskraft and this payment deadline do not arise as stated.

warnings: The payment deadline (two weeks after Rechtskraft) is computed assuming no Einspruch is filed by the 01.10.2026 deadline; if an objection is lodged, this payment date is not applicable and Rechtskraft/payment will follow a different timeline.

The letter's own document date (14.09.2026) differs from the actual documented delivery date shown on the attached Zustellungsurkunde scan (17.09.2026, i.e. a Postzustellung 3 days after issuance); the delivery date was used for the legal deadline calculation as it is the officially certified date.
